Senses.Explanation: A seasonal auspicious formula wishing that celebration or felicity be fitting everywhere, often stated and then tested, qualified, or undercut. Dahui Zonggao supplies the formula undercut deployment through New-Year formula immediately followed by a warning against both worldly and Buddhist calculation. Linye Tongqi supplies the formula beyond delusion and awakening deployment through New-Year address detaching the auspicious formula from delusion and awakening. Huiyue Xu supplies the communal well-wish deployment through direct communal seasonal well-wish after asking what the staff proclaims. Shiyu Mingfang supplies the conditional timely-action verdict deployment through conditional verdict that acting with knowledge of the occasion makes celebration fitting.
